  path_binaries: Q:/CalCurCEAS_fall_2024/analysis/pamguard/binaries/pam20217a_glider_banter_sg680_CalCurCEAS_Sep2024 # path to PG binaries folder, e.g., 'S:/SCOPE_2024_Recording/Binaries', note must use drive letter (not //)

## Setup

```{r start-log, results = 'hide'}

# write progress to a log file (OPTIONAL)
if (exists("log", where = params) & (params$log == TRUE)) {
  logFile <- file.path(params$path_out, 
                       paste0("processing_log_", params$survey, "_", 
                              format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"), ".txt"))
  processingStartTime <- Sys.time()
  writeLines(paste("Processing started:", Sys.time()), logFile)
} else if (!exists("log", where = params)) {
  params$log <- FALSE # set to false if it doesn't exist
}
```

#### Set paths and check files
```{r set-vars, results = 'hide'}
# For generic run, prompt/select all files and paths

# if not using params, prompt for paths/files
if ((!exists("useParamsFlag", where = params)) |
    ((exists("useParamsFlag", where = params) & params$useParamsFlag == FALSE))) {
  # select database file
  dbFile <- tk_choose.files(
    default = "", caption = "Select PAMguard database file",
    filters = matrix(c("sqlite3 files", ".sqlite3", "all files", "*"), 2, 2, 
                     byrow = TRUE))
  # select path to binaries to go with the selected database
  path_binaries <- choose.dir(default = "", caption = "Select PAMguard binaries folder")
  
  # select AcousticStudy RDS file
  acStFile <- tk_choose.files(
    default = "", caption = "Select AcousticStudy detection data file",
    filters = matrix(c("rds files", ".rds", "all files", "*"), 2, 2, byrow = TRUE))
  
  # select filtered AcousticStudy RDS file (if applicable)
  acStFileFilt <- tk_choose.files(
    default = "", caption = "Select filtered
                                    AcousticStudy detection data file",
    filters = matrix(c("rds files", ".rds", "all files", "*"), 2, 2, byrow = TRUE))
  
  # select output folder for event tables and event reports
  path_out <- choose.dir(default = "", caption = "Select output event_reports folder")
  
  # if using params, assemble and check path/file variables
} else if (params$useParamsFlag == TRUE) {
  ###############################
  # if using params, set variables based on params values
  
  # could add whatever params you may want to assemble names and paths to loop
  # through drifts or deployments with less changing of the Rmd
  # e.g., define single path_pg and assemble filepaths and paths
  # dbFile <- file.path(params$path_pg, "Databases", params$pgDatabaseFileName)
  # path_binaries <- file.path(params$path_pg, 'Binaries')
  ###############################
  
  # check for specified AcousticStudy file
  if (exists("acousticStudy", where = params) & exists("path_acSt", where = params)) {
    acStFile <- file.path(params$path_acSt, params$acousticStudy)
    if (!file.exists(acStFile)) {
      acStFile <- tk_choose.files(
        default = "", caption = "Select AcousticStudy detection data file",
        filters = matrix(c("rds files", ".rds", "all files", "*"), 2, 2, 
                         byrow = TRUE))
    }
  }
  
  # check for specified filtered AcousticStudy file
  if (exists("acousticStudyFiltered", where = params) & exists("path_acSt", where = params)) {
    acStFiltFile <- file.path(params$path_acSt, params$acousticStudyFiltered)
    if (!file.exists(acStFiltFile)) {
      # select filtered AcousticStudy RDS file (if applicable)
      acStFiltFile <- tk_choose.files(
        default = "", caption = "Select filtered AcousticStudy detection data file", 
        filters = matrix(c("rds files", ".rds", "all files", "*"), 2, 2, 
                         byrow = TRUE))
    }
  }
  
  # check for specified dbFile or prompt
  if (exists("dbFile", where = params) & (file.exists(params$dbFile))) {
    dbFile <- params$dbFile
  } else {
    dbFile <- tk_choose.files(
      default = "", caption = "Select PAMguard database file", 
      filters = matrix(c("sqlite3 files", ".sqlite3", "all files", "*"), 2, 2, 
                       byrow = TRUE))
  }
  
  # check for specified binaries folder
  if (exists("path_binaries", where = params) & (dir.exists(params$path_binaries))) {
    path_binaries <- params$path_binaries
  } else {
    path_binaries <- choose.dir(default = "", caption = "Select PAMguard binaries folder")
  }
  
  # check for an output path or choose one - for event tables and reports
  if (exists("path_out", where = params) & (dir.exists(params$path_out))) {
    path_out <- params$path_out
  } else {
    path_out <- choose.dir(default = "", caption = "Select output event_reports folder")
  }
  
  # OPTIONAL check for specified calibration file
  if (exists("calFile", where = params) & (params$calFile != FALSE)) {
    if (file.exists(params$acousticStudy_filtered)) {
      calFile <- params$calFile
    } else {
      calFile <- tk_choose.files(
        default = "", caption = "Select calibration file",
        filters = matrix(c("txt files", ".txt", "all files", "*"), 2, 2, 
                         byrow = TRUE))
    }
  }
  
  # OPTIONAL reference spectra - set files and colors (will load later)
  if (exists("refSpec", where = params) & (params$refSpec != FALSE)) {
    # read in or define the path to the reference spectra
    if (exists("path_refSpec", where = params) & (dir.exists(params$path_refSpec))) {
      path_refSpec <- params$path_refSpec
    } else {
      path_refSpec <- choose.dir(default = "", caption = "Select PAMguard binaries folder")
    }
    # assemble the reference spectra paths
    if (!exists("refSpecList", where = params) | !exist("refSpecSp", where = params)) {
      stop("Error: reference spectra list or species not specified in params")
    } else {
      refSpecs <- list()
      refSpecs$path_refSpec <- file.path(params$path_to_refSpec) # pull from YAML
      refSpecs$refSpecList <- params$refSpecList # pull from YAML
      refSpecs$refSpecSp <- params$refSpecSp # pull from YAML
      # reference spectra colors - allows for up to 6 ref specs
      # pastel
      # rsPalette <- c('#66c2a5', '#fc8d62', '#8da0cb', '#e78ac3',
      #                '#a6d854', '#ffd92f')
      # bold
      refSpecs$rsPalette <- c(
        "#1b9e77", "#d95f02", "#7570b3", "#e7298a",
        "#66a61e", "#e6ab02"
      )}}}

# set up cache output subdirectory in path_out
if (!dir.exists(file.path(path_out, 'event_cache'))){
  dir.create(file.path(path_out, 'event_cache'))
}
path_cache <- file.path(path_out, 'event_cache', 
                       paste0(params$survey, '_', Sys.Date()))
if (!dir.exists(path_cache)) {
  dir.create(path_cache)
}

# # more misc set up

# set time zone to UTC
Sys.setenv(TZ = "UTC")
```

#### Load and prep AcousticStudies

Load an existing `acSt` PAMpal AcousticStudy object for event processing. Load both the unfiltered `acSt` and filtered `acStFilt` AcousticStudies to compare total detection counts from each; plots and summary tables will be from filtered data.

```{r prep-acSt, results = 'hide'}
# load existing acSt AcousticStudy (created with
# workflow_generate_acousticStudies.R)
if (file.exists(acStFile)) {
  acSt <- readRDS(acStFile)
  cat("Loaded", acStFile, "\n")
} else {
  stop("No AcousticStudy 'acSt' file available. Exiting report.", "\n")
}
# update file paths if needed
acSt <- updateFiles(acSt, db = dbFile, bin = path_binaries)
# save with updated paths?
# saveRDS(acSt, file = sub("\\.rds$", "_newPaths.rds", acStFile))

if (file.exists(acStFiltFile)) {
  acStFilt <- readRDS(acStFiltFile)
  cat("Loaded", acStFiltFile, "\n")
} else {
  stop("No AcousticStudy 'acStFilt' file available. Exiting report.", "\n")
  # acStFilt <- acSt # **hack for looking at unfiltered data** use this if testing/no filtered AS exists
}

# update file paths if needed (e.g., data was moved on HD or server)
acStFilt <- updateFiles(acStFilt, db = dbFile, bin = path_binaries)
# save with updated paths?
# saveRDS(acStFilt, file = sub("\\.rds$", "_newPaths.rds", acStFiltFile))

# summarize how many events
nEvents <- length(names(events(acSt)))
# number of events may change after filtering (all clicks may be filtered out)
nEventsFilt <- length(names(events(acStFilt)))

if (params$log == TRUE) {
  cat(paste("AcousticStudies loaded:", Sys.time()), file = logFile, 
      append = TRUE, sep = "\n")
}
```

Loaded `r acStFile` and `r acStFiltFile`:

**`r nEvents` events** before filtering and **`r nEventsFilt` events** after initial filtering of clicks to remove noise.


#### Load reference spectra, if specified

Load the reference spectra for plotting, if set with `refSpecList`.
```{r load-refSpec}
# refSpecList is specified in YAML params. Can be one or multiple species
# for single species specify as char string without quotations e.g., refSpecPc
# for multiple species, specify with call to R and c()
#     e.g., !r c('meanSpecGm', 'refSpecPc_LLHARP')

if (exists("refSpec", where = params) & (params$calFile != FALSE)) {
  if (!is.null(refSpecs)) {
    for (rs in refSpecs$refSpecList) {
      refSpecs[[rs]] <- read.csv(file.path(refSpecs$path_to_refSpec, paste0(rs, ".csv")))
    }
  }
} else {
  refSpecs <- NULL
}
```

## Generate event summary table

Summarize all events and create an event summary table with by-event summary 
statistics. This table can be used to guide and track manual assessment and can
be used to flag candidate events based on species-specific criteria. Information
extracted here can be used to plot event summary tiles in different groupings, 
if desired (e.g., possible false killer whales first).

In this run, no flagging of candidate events for a particular species is done. 

```{r event-table}
# set up output data frame
evTable <- data.frame(
  survey = character(nEventsFilt),
  eventId = character(nEventsFilt)
) # ,
# species = character(nEvents))

# populate with cruise string and event names
evTable$survey <- paste0(params$survey)
evTable$eventId <- names(PAMpal::events(acStFilt))

# get all click data
allClicks <- getClickData(acStFilt)
# pull click summary stats
evClickSummary <- allClicks %>%
  group_by(eventId) %>%
  summarise(
    numClicks = n(),
    # numClicks_d0 = sum(detectorName == 'Click_Detector_0', na.rm = TRUE),
    numClicks_d1 = sum(detectorName == "Click_Detector_1", na.rm = TRUE),
    numClicks_d2 = sum(detectorName == "Click_Detector_2", na.rm = TRUE),
    numClicks_d3 = sum(detectorName == "Click_Detector_3", na.rm = TRUE),
    numClicks_d4 = sum(detectorName == "Click_Detector_4", na.rm = TRUE),
    numClicks_d5 = sum(detectorName == "Click_Detector_5", na.rm = TRUE),
    click_medPeakFreq_kHz = median(peak, na.rm = TRUE),
    click_p25PeakFreq_kHz = quantile(peak, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    click_p75PeakFreq_kHz = quantile(peak, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
# add to output evTable
evTable <- evTable %>%
  left_join(evClickSummary, by = c("eventId" = "eventId"))

# get all whistle data
allWhistles <- getWhistleData(acStFilt)
# pull whistle summary stats
evWhistleSummary <- allWhistles %>%
  group_by(eventId) %>%
  summarise(
    numWhistles = n(),
    # whistle_medCenterFreq_Hz = median(freqCenter, na.rm = TRUE),
    # whistle_medMedFreq_Hz = median(freqMedian, na.rm = TRUE),
    whistle_medBeginFreq_Hz = median(freqBeg, na.rm = TRUE)
    # whistle_percBeginFreq4to8kHz = sum(freqBeg >= 4000 & freqBeg <= 8000) / n()
    # whistle_percCenterFreq5to7kHz = sum(freqCenter >= 5000 & freqCenter <= 7000)/n()
    # whistle_percMedianFreq5to7kHz = sum(freqMedian >= 5000 & freqMedian <= 7000)/n()
  )
# add to output evTable
evTable <- evTable %>%
  left_join(evWhistleSummary, by = c("eventId" = "eventId"))

# add column for keeping/removing based on median peak frequency
evTable$keep <- FALSE # set all to false, will mark keepers as TRUE in loop
# # mark true where events meet criteria
# evTable$keep[which( # evTable$numClicks >= 10 &
#   (evTable$numClicks_d1 >= 10 |
#      evTable$numClicks_d2 >= 10 |
#      evTable$numClicks_d3 >= 10 |
#      evTable$numClicks_d4 >= 10 |
#      evTable$numClicks_d5 >= 10 |
#      evTable$numWhistles >= 10) &
#     (is.na(evTable$numClicks) | # if there are clicks check for freq criteria
#        evTable$click_medPeakFreq_kHz <= 22) &
#     (is.na(evTable$numWhistles) | # if there are whistles, check for freq criteria
#        evTable$whistle_medBeginFreq_Hz <= 8100 &
#        evTable$whistle_percBeginFreq4to8kHz >= .5)
# )] <- TRUE

# evTableTrimmed <- evTable[which(evTable$keep == TRUE), ]

# save event table as CSV - saves to path_out in params or chosen
write.csv(evTable, file = file.path(path_out, paste0("eventTable_", params$survey,
                                                     "_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
# write.csv(evTableTrimmed, file = file.path(path_out,
#                                            paste0("eventTableTrimmed_", params$survey,
#                                                   "_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
# the above will be overwritten during the loop below, but this creates placeholders
```

## Summarize individual events

Loop through each event to calculate a suite of summary statistics and generate 
standardized plots for both clicks and whistles (if present). Summary stats and
plots are saved in a "figures" subdirectory of the specified output path for
future reference and plotting. 

```{r process-events}
if (params$log == TRUE) {
  cat(paste("Generating summary stats and plots:", Sys.time()),
    file = logFile,
    append = TRUE, sep = "\n"
  )
}

# get events to process
eventList <- events(acStFilt)
eventNames <- names(events(acStFilt))

if (exists("reCalc", where = params) & params$reCalc == TRUE) {

  for (iEvent in seq_along(eventNames)) { # eventNames
    # iEvent <- 1 # for testing

    # extract this event UID string
    eventUID <- eventNames[iEvent]
    evTableIdx <- which(evTable$eventId == eventUID)

    # log and console output for progress tracking
    logMsg <- paste0(
      "[", format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"), "] iEvent = ",
      iEvent, " / ", nEventsFilt, " | eventUID = ", eventUID
    )
    message(logMsg) # Print to console
    if (params$log == TRUE) {
      cat(logMsg, file = logFile, append = TRUE, sep = "\n")
    }

    # set up output filename prefix
    filePrefix <- file.path(path_cache, eventUID)

    ###### summarize clicks ######
    # this is a slow-ish step. Runs PAMpal::calculateAverageSpectra and creates
    # summary data for formatted tables
    cl <- crputils::er_clickSummary(acStFilt, eventUID, params$snrThreshold)

    saveRDS(cl, file = paste0(filePrefix, "_cl.rds"))

    # save the table if there are valid whistles (its smol)
    if (cl$nClicks > 0) {
      write.csv(cl$mt, file = paste0(filePrefix, "_clickStats.csv"))
    }

    ##### click plots ######
    # if any clicks...
    if (("spec" %in% names(cl)) &
      (cl$nClicks > 0 & ("snrVals" %in% names(cl$spec)))) {
      # plot histogram of all clicks and SNR >= snrThreshold dB cut off
      png(
        file = paste0(filePrefix, "_clickSNR.png"), width = figSize,
        height = figSize, res = figRes, units = "in"
      )
      crputils::er_plotClickSNRHist(cl$spec, params$snrThreshold)
      dev.off()

      # if sufficient good clicks...
      if (cl$nGoodClicks > 0) {
        # plot histogram of click durations - good clicks only
        png(
          file = paste0(filePrefix, "_clickDuration.png"), width = figSize,
          height = figSize, res = figRes, units = "in"
        )
        crputils::er_plotClickDurationHist(cl)
        dev.off()

        # Calculate and plot Concatenated and Mean Spectrum for clicks w/ max SNR > 15dB
        # NB: JLKM uses more exaggerated SNR (>40 dB) for BWs bc actual spectra may
        # be noisy for single clicks
        # reducing wl can give more accurate noise floor but 'smoother' spectrum
        # increasing wl will give more exact spectrum but may exclude too many
        # clicks based on SNR (noise measure will overlap with click output; noise
        # is just measured as same wl from start of binary snippet and binaries
        # binary snippets are v short)
        # Trial and error - 256 works ok for LLHARP data = 1.28 ms
        # NB: JLKM uses 500 for beaked whales with samp rate 288k

        # extracted from PAMpal for efficiency and to add refSpec and median
        if (!is.null(cl$spec)) {
          # concatenated spectrogram
          png(
            file = paste0(filePrefix, "_concatSpec.png"), width = figSize,
            height = figSize, res = figRes, units = "in"
          )
          crputils::er_plotConcatSpec(cl$spec,
            sort = TRUE,
            snrThreshold = params$snrThreshold
          )
          dev.off()

          # average spectrum
          png(
            file = paste0(filePrefix, "_avgSpectrum.png"), width = figSize,
            height = figSize, res = figRes, units = "in"
          )
          crputils::er_plotSpectra(cl$spec,
            refSpecs = refSpecs,
            snrThreshold = params$snrThreshold
          )
          dev.off()
        }

        # NB: JLKM BW approach has additional plots here:
        # IPI
        # Waveform of strongest click
        # Wigner plot
        # We are not including those here because not really useful for FKW, but if
        # interested in adding back in, see:
        #       https://github.com/jlkeating/PAMGuard_Event_Code
      } # check for good SNR clicks
    } # check for any clicks

    # to log
    if (params$log == TRUE) {
      cat("   Clicks done\n", file = logFile, append = TRUE)
    }


    ###### summarize whistles ######
    wl <- crputils::er_whistleSummary(acStFilt, eventUID)

    # save it no matter what (even if 0 whistles)
    saveRDS(wl, file = paste0(filePrefix, "_wl.rds"))

    # save the table if there are valid whistles (its smol)
    if (wl$nWhistles > 0) {
      write.csv(wl$mt, file = paste0(filePrefix, "_whistleStats.csv"))
    }

    ###### whistle plots and table ######

    # if whistles present ...
    if (wl$nWhistles > 0) {
      # plot whistle contours
      png(
        file = paste0(filePrefix, "_whistleContours.png"), width = figSize,
        height = figSize, res = figRes, units = "in"
      )
      crputils::er_plotWhistleContours(acStFilt, eventUID, xMax = 1.5, yMax = 20)
      dev.off()

      # plot histogram of median frequency
      png(
        file = paste0(filePrefix, "_whistleFreqHist.png"), width = figSize,
        height = figSize, res = figRes, units = "in"
      )
      crputils::er_plotWhistleBeginFreqHist(wl)
      dev.off()
    }

    # to log
    if (params$log == TRUE) {
      cat("   Whistles done\n", file = logFile, append = TRUE)
    }

    ###### clean up #####
    rm(cl, wl, eventUID, evTableIdx)
    # run garbage collection to free up memory
    invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))
  }
} else { # check for params$reCalc flag
  if (params$log == TRUE) {
  cat(paste("    Skipping summary stats/plots - already created"),
    file = logFile,
    append = TRUE, sep = "\n"
  )
  }
}


```

## Display event summaries

Each detection event (n = `r nrow(evTable)`) contains standardized plots
and tables of summary statistics for click and whistle detections. 

Click plots (other than the SNR plot) only show clicks with SNRs >= 
`r params$snrThreshold` dB. 

```{r display-events, results = 'asis'}

if (params$log == TRUE) {
  cat(paste("Compiling event plots and tables:", Sys.time()), file = logFile, 
      append = TRUE, sep = "\n")
}

for (iEvent in seq_along(eventNames)){ #eventNames
  # iEvent <- 1 # for testing
  
  # extract this event UID string
  eventUID <- eventNames[iEvent]
  evTableIdx <- which(evTable$eventId == eventUID)
  
  # read in CSVs
  filePrefix <- file.path(path_cache, eventUID)
  # clickStats <- read.csv(paste0(filePrefix, "_clickStats.csv"))
  # whistleStats <- read.csv(paste0(filePrefix, "_whistleStats.csv"))
  cl <- readRDS(paste0(filePrefix, "_cl.rds"))
  wl <- readRDS(paste0(filePrefix, "_wl.rds"))
  
  # set header for this event and print time
  cat("\n\n#### Event ID:   ", eventUID, "\n")
  cat("Time:   ", format(eventList[[eventUID]]@ancillary$grouping$start,
                         "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M%Z"), " to ", 
      format(eventList[[eventUID]]@ancillary$grouping$end, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M%Z"),
      "\n")
  
  ###### detections summary ######
  
  cat("\nEvent contains", nrow(getClickData(acSt[[eventUID]])),
      "original clicks,", paste0("**", cl$nClicks), "valid clicks** after",
      "filtering noise.\n")
  cat("\n")
  
  cat("\nEvent contains", paste0("**", wl$nWhistles), "whistles**.\n")
  cat("\n")
  
  ###### click plots and table ######
  
  # if any clicks...
  if (("spec" %in% names(cl)) & 
      (cl$nClicks > 0 & ("snrVals" %in% names(cl$spec)))) {
    cat("\n##### Click plots and table\n")
    cat("\n SNR histogram includes all filtered clicks. Other plots contain only",
        "clicks with SNR >=", params$snrThreshold, "dB",
        paste0("(**n = ", cl$nGoodClicks, " clicks**).\n"))
    cat("\n")
    
    # SNR plot
    cat("![](", paste0(filePrefix, "_clickSNR.png"), ")")
    
    # if sufficient good clicks...
    if (cl$nGoodClicks > 0) {
      # plot histogram of click durations - good clicks only
      cat("![](", paste0(filePrefix, "_clickDuration.png"), ")")
      
      cat("\n")
      cat("\n")
      
      if (!is.null(cl$spec)) {
        # concatenated spectrogram
        cat("![](", paste0(filePrefix, "_concatSpec.png"), ")")
        # average spectrum
        cat("![](", paste0(filePrefix, "_avgSpectrum.png"), ")")
      }
      
      cat("\n")
      cat("\n")
      
      # median stats table for clicks with pseudo-SNR dB TK noise cut off
      cat("\n\n##### Median statistics for", cl$nGoodClicks, "high SNR clicks",
          "with SNR >=", params$snrThreshold, "dB.")
      cat("\n")
      
      cat(knitr::kable(cl$mt,format = "html", caption = "", align = "l",
                       row.names = FALSE) %>%
            kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("basic", "condensed"), full_width = F))
      
    } else { # no good clicks so no summary plots/table
      cat("\nNo clicks of sufficient SNR to plot or summarize.\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("\nNo clicks present after filtering for noise.\n")
  }
  
  
  ###### whistle plots and table ######
  
  # if whistles present ...
  if (wl$nWhistles > 0) {
    cat("\n##### Whistle plots and table\n")
    
    # plot whistle contours
    cat("![](", paste0(filePrefix, "_whistleContours.png"), ")")
    # plot histogram of median frequency
    cat("![](", paste0(filePrefix, "_whistleFreqHist.png"), ")")
    
    cat("\n")
    cat("\n")
    
    cat("Median statistics for n = ", wl$nWhistles, "whistles.\n")
    # create median stats table for all whistles
    cat(knitr::kable(wl$mt, format = "html", caption = "", align = "l",
                     row.names = FALSE) %>%
          kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("basic", "condensed"), full_width = F))
  } else {
    cat("\nNo whistles present.\n")
  }
  
  cat("\n")
  cat("\n\n --- \n\n")
  cat("\n")
  
  # clean up after each event
  # remove event-specific variables
  if (exists("cl")) rm(cl)
  if (exists("wl")) rm(wl)
  rm(eventUID, evTableIdx)
  # run garbage collection to free up memory
  invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))
}
```

# close out the log with elapsed time
if (params$log == TRUE) {
  elapsedTime <- Sys.time() - processingStartTime
  logMsg <- paste0("Processing complete: ", Sys.time(), 
                   " (Elapsed time: ", round(elapsedTime, 2), ")")
  cat(logMsg, file = logFile, append = TRUE, sep = "\n")
}
